meta.policy: Adjudicate inherited claims without editing prior editions.

findings.subject: Root EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and data/costs.json
findings.finding: The 0.42% figure is the full bid/ask gap divided by the ask, described as a round-trip loss. It is not the one-way midpoint spread proxy used by Edition E.
findings.adjudication: Different metric, not a universal conversion cost. Edition E publishes both definitions and uses a labelled one-way proxy.

findings.subject: data/costs.json K9 and scripts/data_costs.py
findings.finding: Blanket statement that a CNY deposit coupon is taxed at 20% and nets 80% conflicts with the retrieved savings-deposit interest exemption from 2008-10-09.
findings.adjudication: Overbroad. Edition E limits the statutory 20% category to non-exempt items and leaves personal tax blank.

findings.subject: Older crypto authority in root/edition-b/edition-c and published Edition D
findings.finding: Sources cite 2021 No.237. PBOC 2026 No.42 expressly repeals that notice.
findings.adjudication: Outdated authority. Practical prohibition remains, but Edition E cites the current notice.

findings.subject: data/channels.json B1, data/costs.json K7, edition-d/data/parameters.json emigration
findings.finding: Old staged 50%/25%/25% release schedule is presented as current. The 2014 circular allows lump sum or batches within approval; full current section 6.4 was not isolated.
findings.adjudication: Not confirmed current. Edition E leaves staging blank and flags local-office confirmation.

findings.subject: edition-b/data/flagged.json F08 and older no-tariff statements
findings.finding: Earlier editions say no retail tariff/spread was retrieved. Current BOC personal and SC China provider tariffs were retrieved in this session.
findings.adjudication: Historical limitation superseded for Edition E. Provider prices are still not government rates or executable quotes.

findings.subject: edition-d receiving-bank assumption and total-cost cells
findings.finding: Published Edition D includes a named USD 15 Chase receiving-bank assumption to complete totals. The user supplied no receiving bank.
findings.adjudication: Labelled assumption is not a verified personal value. Edition E leaves receiving fees and all-in totals blank.

findings.subject: edition-d BOC tariff vintage and full-arrival source
findings.finding: Edition D uses a 2014 personal e-banking tariff and a corporate/trade-finance full-arrival announcement. This session retrieved the current personal tariff effective 2025-11-11, including the USD full-arrival note.
findings.adjudication: Edition E uses the current personal schedule and keeps the optional surcharge separate from base sender tariff.

findings.subject: edition-d board timestamp timezone
findings.finding: Edition D labels the BOC board stamp as Beijing time. The retrieved board did not establish the timezone for this session.
findings.adjudication: Edition E preserves the publisher timestamp and flags timezone/date mismatch instead of asserting a timezone.

findings.subject: IRS Publication 525 personal-FX rule
findings.finding: The USD 200 tip is supported by an official search excerpt, but the targeted full-body passage was not isolated by repeated chunk fetches.
findings.adjudication: disclosed as excerpt-only; no personal FX gain is computed.

findings.subject: Concurrent edition collision
findings.finding: Another session published edition-d while this session was researching. An untracked-file rebase conflict prevented overwriting it.
findings.adjudication: This session relocated its isolated outputs to edition-e, merged main, and preserved the published Edition D unchanged.
